Level checked: about 2970 kWh per flat a year = real Barcelona homes 2024 (Datadis residential total / 704600 households)

CEA OFFICE (SIA 2024) with LED lighting; always_on = servers and standby; July-August intensive hours 8-15; base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level checked: about 100 kWh/m2 a year, typical Spanish office (Repsol, citing sector data)

CEA RETAIL (SIA 2024) lighting reduced to LED; base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level checked: about 130 kWh/m2 a year, inside the Barcelona benchmark for pharmacies (good: 70-160)

CEA FOODSTORE (SIA 2024); always_on = fridges and freezers (refrigeration electricity); base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level set to about 300 kWh/m2 a year, inside the Barcelona food-shop benchmark (185-430); weakest source

CEA RESTAURANT plus electric kitchen equipment; always_on = fridges; base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level set to about 200 kWh/m2 a year, near the Barcelona food benchmark (good up to 185); no source for restaurants alone

Like restaurant: coffee machine and display fridges; always_on = fridges; base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level set to about 200 kWh/m2 a year, like restaurant; no source for bars alone

No CEA type; projection and sound plus large ventilation and cooling load; base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level checked: about 100 kWh/m2 a year, Barcelona leisure and culture benchmark (good: 85-105)

CEA SCHOOL (SIA 2024); closed in Catalan school holidays; base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level checked: about 25 kWh/m2 a year, audit of 17 schools in El Prat (1075 MWh / 42560 m2)

CEA UNIVERSITY (SIA 2024); always_on = labs and servers; closed in August and over Christmas; base load (always_on) raised and AC lowered so the services mix matches 08018 (night share, Sunday level). Level checked: about 75 kWh/m2 a year, UPF Campus del Poblenou 2018-2019 (77 and 74 kWh/m2)

CEA HOTEL (SIA 2024) appliances and lighting; hourly shape = CEA guest-room shape lifted by 0.35 for lifts, corridors, kitchen and laundry (assumption); always_on = lifts, corridors, fridges, pumps; AC runs at night too (guests sleep there): hvac_min_on 0.8. Level set to about 125 kWh/m2 a year: IDAE survey of 153 Spanish hotels, 6150 kWh per room a year in 4-5 star hotels, at about 50 m2 per room (ZT hotel: Catastro 7602 m2 for 150 rooms); Repsol gives 30-50 kWh/m2 for an average hotel, so this level is uncertain

CEA GYM (SIA 2024) appliances and lighting; hourly shape with Spanish peaks (7-9, lunch 13-14, evening 18-21; assumption); always_on = ventilation, hot water, sauna/hammam standby; large ventilation so AC per degree is high. Level set to about 100 kWh/m2 a year: electricity in Madrid municipal sports centre audits (74-227 kWh/m2; Gimnasio Moscardo 97, La Chopera 89); weak source
